# AP News

> AP News is the Associated Press’s digital news platform for breaking news, independent reporting, photos, and video from around the world.

AP News publishes real-time coverage across U.S. and world affairs, politics, business, sports, entertainment, climate, health, and regional news. The site also includes topic hubs, live coverage pages, newsletters, video, photography, and explainers that help readers follow major developing stories.

## Main News Hubs
- [AP News Homepage](https://apnews.com/): Front page with top stories, breaking news, video, and featured coverage.
- [World News](https://apnews.com/world-news): Global breaking news, international affairs, conflicts, and diplomacy coverage.
- [U.S. News](https://apnews.com/us-news): National news covering policy, public safety, courts, and domestic developments.
- [Politics](https://apnews.com/politics): U.S. politics, elections, Congress, the White House, and campaigns.
- [Sports](https://apnews.com/sports): Scores, game coverage, athlete news, and major sports events.
- [Entertainment](https://apnews.com/entertainment): Film, television, music, celebrities, and culture reporting.
- [Business](https://apnews.com/business): Markets, companies, the economy, labor, and consumer news.
- [Science](https://apnews.com/science): Research, space, technology, and scientific developments.

## U.S. Coverage
- [U.S. News](https://apnews.com/us-news): National reporting on major events, policy, crime, and public affairs.
- [Politics](https://apnews.com/politics): Coverage of elections, campaigns, government, and political institutions.
- [Education](https://apnews.com/hub/education): Reporting on schools, universities, policy, and student issues.
- [Health](https://apnews.com/health): Public health, medicine, outbreaks, and healthcare system news.
- [Climate and Environment](https://apnews.com/climate-and-environment): Climate policy, extreme weather, energy, and environmental reporting.
- [Religion](https://apnews.com/religion): Faith communities, religious institutions, and religion-related current events.
- [Oddities](https://apnews.com/oddities): Unusual, offbeat, and human-interest news stories.

## World & Regional Coverage
- [World News](https://apnews.com/world-news): International headlines, diplomacy, conflict, and global developments.
- [Asia Pacific](https://apnews.com/hub/asia-pacific): Regional coverage from East Asia, South Asia, and Oceania.
- [Europe](https://apnews.com/hub/europe): News from European countries, institutions, and regional crises.
- [Latin America](https://apnews.com/hub/latin-america): Politics, society, migration, and economic news across Latin America.
- [Africa](https://apnews.com/hub/africa): Reporting on politics, conflict, development, and society across Africa.
- [Middle East](https://apnews.com/hub/middle-east): Regional conflict, diplomacy, and political developments in the Middle East.
- [China](https://apnews.com/hub/china): Coverage of Chinese politics, economy, diplomacy, and society.
- [Russia-Ukraine War](https://apnews.com/hub/russia-ukraine): Ongoing reporting and updates on the war in Ukraine.

## Business, Tech & Economy
- [Business](https://apnews.com/business): Corporate, economic, labor, and financial market coverage.
- [Financial Markets](https://apnews.com/hub/financial-markets): Stocks, bonds, interest rates, and market-moving developments.
- [Economy](https://apnews.com/hub/economy): Inflation, jobs, growth, and macroeconomic policy reporting.
- [Technology](https://apnews.com/technology): Tech companies, digital policy, AI, cybersecurity, and gadgets.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://apnews.com/hub/artificial-intelligence): AI tools, regulation, business adoption, and societal impacts.
- [Personal Finance](https://apnews.com/hub/personal-finance): Consumer money topics including savings, debt, taxes, and retirement.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://apnews.com/hub/cryptocurrency): Digital assets, regulation, exchanges, and crypto market developments.

## Science, Health & Environment
- [Science](https://apnews.com/science): Scientific discoveries, research institutions, and space exploration coverage.
- [Health](https://apnews.com/health): Medical research, public health, disease outbreaks, and healthcare policy.
- [Climate and Environment](https://apnews.com/climate-and-environment): Climate science, conservation, pollution, and environmental policy.
- [Weather](https://apnews.com/weather): Storms, forecasts, disasters, and weather-related impacts.
- [Space](https://apnews.com/hub/space): Space missions, astronomy, NASA, and commercial spaceflight news.
- [Wildfires](https://apnews.com/hub/wildfires): Fire outbreaks, emergency response, and wildfire impact coverage.
- [Pandemics](https://apnews.com/hub/pandemics): Disease spread, preparedness, and public health response reporting.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://apnews.com/sports): Main sports hub with breaking news and event coverage.
- [NFL](https://apnews.com/hub/nfl): National Football League news, games, players, and transactions.
- [NBA](https://apnews.com/hub/nba): Basketball coverage including teams, players, and league developments.
- [MLB](https://apnews.com/hub/mlb): Baseball news, standings, trades, and game recaps.
- [NHL](https://apnews.com/hub/nhl): Hockey coverage with league, team, and player updates.
- [College Football](https://apnews.com/hub/college-football): Rankings, games, coaching moves, and season coverage.
- [Soccer](https://apnews.com/hub/soccer): International and club soccer news, tournaments, and transfers.
- [Olympics](https://apnews.com/hub/olympic-games): Olympic sports coverage, athletes, and event developments.

## Entertainment & Lifestyle
- [Entertainment](https://apnews.com/entertainment): Movies, TV, music, awards, and celebrity news.
- [Movies](https://apnews.com/hub/movies): Film releases, reviews, festivals, and industry developments.
- [Music](https://apnews.com/hub/music): Artists, albums, tours, awards, and music business reporting.
- [Television](https://apnews.com/hub/television): TV series, networks, streaming, and industry coverage.
- [Books](https://apnews.com/hub/books): Publishing news, authors, releases, and literary coverage.
- [Fashion](https://apnews.com/hub/fashion): Fashion industry, designers, trends, and runway reporting.
- [Travel](https://apnews.com/hub/travel): Travel disruptions, destinations, tourism, and transportation-related news.

## Topic Hubs & Ongoing Stories
- [Elections](https://apnews.com/elections): Election results, campaign developments, and voter-focused coverage.
- [Fact Check](https://apnews.com/APFactCheck): AP fact-checking of claims, misinformation, and viral content.
- [Immigration](https://apnews.com/hub/immigration): Border policy, migration trends, asylum, and enforcement reporting.
- [Gun Violence](https://apnews.com/hub/gun-violence): Shootings, firearm policy, and public safety coverage.
- [Supreme Court](https://apnews.com/hub/us-supreme-court): Cases, rulings, and legal developments from the high court.
- [Congress](https://apnews.com/hub/congress): Legislative activity, leadership, and federal policymaking coverage.
- [Donald Trump](https://apnews.com/hub/donald-trump): News and analysis related to Donald Trump and his campaigns.
- [Israel-Hamas War](https://apnews.com/hub/israel-hamas-war): Reporting on the conflict, diplomacy, and humanitarian impacts.

## Multimedia & Reader Services
- [Video](https://apnews.com/video): News video clips, live coverage, and visual reports.
- [Photography](https://apnews.com/apf-photo): AP photo journalism and image-driven storytelling.
- [Live Coverage](https://apnews.com/live): Live blogs and rolling updates for major developing stories.
- [Newsletters](https://apnews.com/newsletters): Email newsletters covering top news, politics, and sports.
- [Listen](https://apnews.com/hub/ap-top-news-podcast): Audio news updates and AP podcast content.
- [AP Buyline Shopping](https://apnews.com/ap-buyline-shopping): Product guides and commerce-related editorial content.

## About AP
- [About The Associated Press](https://apnews.com/about): Overview of AP, its mission, and organization.
- [Contact Us](https://apnews.com/contact-us): Contact information and ways to reach AP News.
- [Careers](https://apnews.com/careers): Employment opportunities and newsroom or corporate roles.
- [Standards and Ethics](https://apnews.com/ap-news-values-and-principles): AP editorial values, principles, and journalism standards.
- [Corrections](https://apnews.com/hub/corrections): Published corrections and clarifications to AP reporting.
- [Press Releases](https://apnews.com/press-release): Corporate and organizational press release distribution content.
